dashboard.title: Ready for your next device batch
dashboard.description: Manage network boot, system images, and deployment jobs in one place. Every disk write requires explicit confirmation.
dashboard.imagesHint: Verified WIM/ESD and single-file partition GHO images
dashboard.setupDescription: Complete three foundation steps before creating the first deployment batch.
dashboard.networkStepHint: The service listens only on an explicitly selected wired interface.
dashboard.bootPackStepHint: Contains the EasyDeployMesh Agent and legally licensed deployment tools.
dashboard.imageStepHint: Automatic deployment supports verified WIM/ESD and natively verified single-file partition GHO images. SWM and spanned GHO are archive-only.
dashboard.networkDescription: Network addresses currently detected on this computer.
dashboard.recentDescription: Job state is recorded independently for each client device.
dashboard.noJobsHint: After setup, create a job from the image library.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Inspect WinPE and Windows devices registered through the EasyDeployMesh Agent and their hardware inventory.
devices.emptyDescription: Select a deployment interface and start the control service in Settings first.
devices.waitingForAgents: The control service is running. Run the Agent command shown in Settings on a target computer.
devices.noDisksReported: The client has not reported disk information
devices.sendAllTitle: Deploy image to all available clients ({count})
devices.sendDescription: Select a verified WIM or ESD image, or a natively verified GHO image, and a target disk to create a deployment job for this client.
devices.sendSelectedDescription: A separate image deployment job will be created for each of the {count} selected online clients.
devices.sendAllDescription: A separate image deployment job will be created for each of the {count} online clients that reported a disk.
devices.selectNoDiskHint: Clients without a reported disk cannot be selected
devices.imageIndexHint: Select the Windows edition index to apply. Index 1 is used by default.
devices.targetUnavailableHint: The client went offline, was removed, or no longer reports a disk. Close this window, refresh, and try again.
devices.sendSelectedDiskHint: Verify each target disk. The first non-system disk is selected by default, or the first disk when no other disk is available.
devices.sendAllDiskHint: All includes only clients that are currently online and reported a disk. Verify every target disk.
devices.partitionTemplateHint: Recommended mode selects GPT or MBR from each client's boot mode.
devices.partitionWindowsAndData: Custom C drive + remaining D drive
devices.windowsPartitionSizeHint: 20 GiB or more is recommended but not enforced. Deployment rebuilds the disk, installs Windows to the requested system partition, and creates a Data partition from the remaining space (normally D:).
devices.smallWindowsPartitionWarning: The C drive is only {size} GiB, below the recommended 20 GiB. The image may fail to install, update, or run correctly. Continue anyway?
devices.templateEditorHint: Boot partitions are generated automatically for UEFI or Legacy. Limits and remaining-space previews use the smallest target's actual byte capacity after reserving image cache, alignment, boot partitions, and the minimum remaining volume.
devices.templateSaveFailed: Could not save the partition template. Check local storage access and try again.

templateErrors.name: Enter a template name.
templateErrors.windows: The template must contain one Windows partition.
templateErrors.remaining: Exactly one partition must use remaining space.
templateErrors.driveLetter: Data partition drive letters must be unique.
templateErrors.label: Labels may contain up to 32 ASCII letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, or hyphens.
templateErrors.size: Partition sizes must be positive whole numbers.
templateErrors.windowsSize: The Windows partition must be at least 20 GiB.

devices.bootModeRequiredHint: The target did not report its boot mode. Select UEFI / GPT or Legacy BIOS / MBR explicitly before sending.
devices.bootModeRequiredSelectedHint: These clients did not report a boot mode: {names}. Select UEFI / GPT or Legacy BIOS / MBR explicitly before sending.
devices.partitionCapacityInsufficientTitle: Partition plan does not fit the target disk
devices.partitionCapacityInsufficientHint: These clients do not have enough disk capacity: {names}. The smallest target requires {required}, provides {available}, and assigns {fixed} to fixed partitions. Reduce the fixed partitions; boot partitions, image cache, alignment reserve, and the minimum remaining partition are included.
devices.destructiveTitle: Deploying an image overwrites the target disk
devices.destructiveDescription: Existing partitions and data on the target disk may be permanently deleted. Verify the image and target disk before continuing.
devices.confirmDeployment: I verified the target machines and disks and agree to overwrite their data
devices.sendingProgress: Processed {completed} of {total} clients. Keep this window open.
devices.sendInterruptedHint: Target state changed while jobs were being created. {success} jobs were created and {remaining} clients were not queued; {retryable} still-deployable clients were kept for review.
devices.sendQueuedHint: A separate waiting job was created for each of the {count} clients.
devices.sendPartiallyQueued: Some clients could not be queued
devices.sendPartiallyQueuedHint: Queued: {success}; failed: {failed}. The {retryable} failed clients that remain deployable are still selected for retry.
devices.sendAllPartiallyQueuedHint: Queued: {success}; failed: {failed}. The {retryable} failed clients that remain deployable were selected automatically; use Deploy selected to retry.
devices.sendFailed: Could not create the image deployment job
devices.sendNoDiskHint: This client has not reported a disk
devices.sendNoImageHint: Import and verify a WIM or ESD image, or natively verify a single-file partition GHO first
devices.registeredHint: A device is shown as offline when its Agent heartbeat is missing for more than 35 seconds.
devices.pxeDiscoveredHint: Shows clients that recently responded to PXE. Brief discovery records expire automatically, and clients are merged after WinPE starts the Agent.
devices.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}”? The device must enroll again before it can reconnect.

images.title: Image library
images.description: Import and verify WIM, ESD, or GHO images. Natively verified single-file partition GHO images can be deployed.
images.emptyDescription: Import WIM, ESD, or GHO images. EasyDeployMesh verifies integrity and discovers GHS spans automatically; SWM and spanned GHO remain archive-only.
images.availableHint: Import creates a managed copy in the app data directory. Removing it from the library does not delete the original source file.
images.automaticDeploymentHint: Verified WIM/ESD images can be used for automatic deployment.
images.manualDeploymentHint: Natively verified single-file partition GHO images can only create manual jobs.
images.verificationRequiredHint: WIM/ESD must pass verification. A GHO must be a natively verified, single-file, password-free NTFS partition image.
images.catalogOnlyHint: SWM and spanned GHO files can be imported and archived, but cannot currently be deployed.
images.desktopOnly: Import images from the EasyDeployMesh desktop app
images.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}” from the library? The source file will not be deleted.

ghoReadiness.nativeDescription: Verification fully decodes a single-file, password-free partition NTFS GHO and records its expanded digest.
ghoReadiness.title: Native GHO verification
ghoReadiness.description: Fully revalidate the managed copy of “{name}” without restoring a system.
ghoReadiness.assessmentFailed: Native GHO verification could not complete
ghoReadiness.verificationBlocked: Verification completed, but the image remains unsupported

jobs.title: Deployment jobs
jobs.description: Schedule image restoration for one or more client devices.
jobs.createHint: Available after device registration and target-disk confirmation
jobs.emptyDescription: After a device comes online, choose an image and target disk to create a job. Every job is confirmed again before starting.
jobs.loadFailed: Deployment jobs could not be loaded
jobs.removeConfirm: Delete deployment job “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
jobs.removeFailed: Deployment job could not be deleted
jobs.pauseRiskConfirm: Pause deployment job “{name}”? Force-suspending a disk-writing process may damage the target system or file system and the deployment might not resume. Confirm that you accept this risk.
jobs.pauseFailed: Deployment job could not be paused
jobs.resumeFailed: Deployment job could not be resumed

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: See what happened across network services, devices, and deployment jobs.
logs.emptyDescription: New activity from services, devices, and deployment jobs will appear here.
logs.noMatchesDescription: Change or clear the current filters.

events.controlFailed: Agent control service failed to start
events.pxeFailed: PXE network service failed to start
events.pxeAccepted: Responded to a device network boot request
events.bootFileSent: Sent boot file {fileName} to a device
events.tftpFailed: Failed to send a boot file to a device
events.jobQueued: Deployment job is waiting for a device
events.jobStarted: A device started the deployment job

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure language, network services, and default deployment behavior.
settings.appearanceHint: Language changes apply immediately and are stored on this computer.
settings.networkHint: Start the Agent control service protected by an enrollment token.
settings.desktopOnly: Start the control service from the EasyDeployMesh desktop app
settings.listenConfigurationHint: The service binds only to an explicitly selected local IPv4 address and never listens on every interface.
settings.deploymentInterfaceHint: Choose a wired interface on the same local network as the target devices.
settings.controlPortHint: HTTP port used for Agent enrollment and heartbeats.
settings.enrollmentTokenHint: The token exists only for this service session and rotates automatically after a stop and restart.
settings.serviceIdleHint: Choose an interface and start the service to display the Agent enrollment command.
settings.securityTitle: The current control channel is for trusted, isolated LANs
settings.securityDescription: Enrollment and per-device tokens are enabled, but TLS and certificate pinning are not complete. Do not start the service on a public or untrusted network.
settings.pxeHint: Provide standalone DHCP or ProxyDHCP with read-only TFTP boot file transfer.
settings.pxeNetworkDetected: Network settings filled from the current interface
settings.pxeAutoDetectFailed: Could not derive PXE network settings from the current interface
settings.pxeManualEditHint: Auto-fill provides suggested values only. The subnet mask, pool, gateway, and DNS remain editable.
settings.wepeUnsupportedHint: WePE uses a private boot chain, so EasyDeployMesh cannot currently guarantee that an Agent-injected image will boot and deploy correctly. The import was cancelled to avoid creating an unusable boot package.
settings.peRequiredForControl: Import a PE boot package first
settings.peRequiredForControlHint: The control service needs to write the Agent configuration into WinPE. Import third-party PE media or a PXE/WinPE directory, then try again.
settings.pxeBiosUnavailable: The media has no PXEboot.n12. UEFI x64 is available; Legacy BIOS requires a separate iPXE or Windows PXE loader.
settings.noPxePackageHint: Import a PXE directory or third-party PE image to enable the service.
settings.pxePackageReadyHint: Boot files are managed by EasyDeployMesh and ready for PXE service startup.
settings.pxeImportFailed: Could not import PXE boot package
settings.pxeStartFailed: PXE service could not be started
settings.pxeStopFailed: PXE service could not be stopped
